title: Pure fizzbuzz classifier function (single Python module)
prompt:
Build a single Python file named `classify.py` that defines one function:

    def classify(n: int) -> str

It returns a lowercase string for the integer `n`:
- `"fizzbuzz"` when `n` is divisible by both 3 and 5.
- `"fizz"` when `n` is divisible by 3 (but not 5).
- `"buzz"` when `n` is divisible by 5 (but not 3).
- Otherwise the decimal string of the number itself, e.g. `classify(7)` returns `"7"`.

Examples: `classify(3) == "fizz"`, `classify(5) == "buzz"`, `classify(15) == "fizzbuzz"`, `classify(2) == "2"`.

Keep everything in the single `classify.py` file. Pure function, no I/O.
